contract.limits: Text/cache presence and object counts do not establish semantic equivalence, workbook correctness, animation behavior, or visual quality

review_evidence: Host-recorded observations bound to current file/images; the CLI cannot prove an image was actually viewed

visual_review.summary: Editorial alternative inspected: bilingual terms are complete, type and section drawing establish separate focal levels, definitions fit on a shared baseline; no visible clipping. 编辑方案字体与图解主次清晰，中英定义完整，无裁切。

Technical alternative inspected after reordering definitions: shade, opening and reflection leader lines reach the corresponding features without crossing each other; bilingual labels and caption are readable. 已重排定义顺序，三条标注线对应部位且互不交叉。
Gallery alternative inspected: large title and light path dominate, dark background supports the diagram, marginal definitions have legible contrast and no clipped CJK text. 画廊方案光路与标题突出，边注完整，中文显示正常。

Three alternatives for one brief, explicitly labeled as composition studies rather than a coherent finished deck. Same three concepts retained; native objects verified. Single-page images and the sequence inspected. These observations do not establish an independent aesthetic benchmark. 三种备选构图保留相同概念，已实看每页与顺序，不能据此推断普遍审美提升。

limits: Authored alternatives; not a blinded model comparison. LibreOffice/macOS rendering; Microsoft PowerPoint itself not tested.
